failure_categories.top1: a gold passage is ranked first
failure_categories.in_context: a gold passage is in ranks 2-5 (inside the generator's context)
failure_categories.ranked_low: a gold passage is retrieved, but below the context cut-off (ranks 6-10) or only in a first-stage top-50 list
failure_categories.right_doc_wrong_passage: the gold document is in the context, but not the gold passage
failure_categories.related_doc: the context has a related document (same title family), not the gold one
failure_categories.not_retrieved: neither the gold passage nor its document (nor a related one) is found
